description: This file defines a service class for interacting with Azure Blob Storage, including methods for listing, downloading, and uploading blobs, along with custom exception classes for error handling.

classes.name: AzureBlobError
classes.description: Base exception class for Azure Blob storage errors.

classes.name: BlobNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a requested blob is not found.

classes.name: ContainerNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a specified container is not found.

classes.name: BlobAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a blob that already exists without overwrite permission.

classes.name: AzureBlobService
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to list, download, and upload blobs in Azure Storage with retry policies and error handling.

methods.name: AzureBlobError _map_azure_error(exc: AzureError)
methods.description: Maps Azure SDK exceptions to custom internal error types.

methods.name: None __init__(self, connection_string: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the AzureBlobService with connection string and retry policies.

methods.name: ContainerClient _container_client(self, container: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a container client for interacting with a specific container.

methods.name: BlobClient _blob_client(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a blob client for a specific blob inside a container.

methods.name: Generator[str,None,None] list_blobs(self, container: str, prefix: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists names of blobs in a container, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: str download_text(self, container: str, blob_name: str, encoding: str = "utf-8")
methods.description: Downloads the contents of a blob as a UTF-8 encoded string.

methods.name: bytes download_bytes(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Downloads the contents of a blob as raw bytes.

methods.name: None upload_text( self, container: str, blob_name: str, data: str, overwrite: Optional[bool] = None, content_type: str = "text/plain; charset=utf-8", encoding: str = "utf-8", )
methods.description: Uploads a string as a blob with specified content type and encoding.

methods.name: None upload_bytes( self, container: str, blob_name: str, data: bytes | io.BytesIO, overwrite: Optional[bool] = None, content_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Uploads raw bytes or BytesIO as a blob, with optional content type.

methods.name: bool exists(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific blob exists in a container.
